description: Área de Risco Geológico 2009 IPT (Arquivos para Download) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Polígonos que delimitam as áreas de risco geológico em áreas de encostas e margens de córrego em assentamentos precários com potencial para a ocorrência de deslizamentos e processos de solapamento de margem (erosão) no Município de São Paulo levantadas pelo IPT/SMSP entre 2009 e 2010. Esta camada está disponibilizada no portal somente para download. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Meio físico, Desastres, geoscientificInformation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
